import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def binary_search_lower_bound_precond (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  seq.size ≤ 0x7FFFFFFF ∧
  (∀ i j : Nat, i < j ∧ j < seq.size → seq.getD i 0 ≤ seq.getD j 0)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def lbLoop (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (lo hi fuel : Nat) : Nat :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => lo
  | fuel + 1 =>
      if lo < hi then
        if seq.getD ((lo + hi) / 2) 0 < target then
          lbLoop seq target ((lo + hi) / 2 + 1) hi fuel
        else
          lbLoop seq target lo ((lo + hi) / 2) fuel
      else lo
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def binary_search_lower_bound (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (h_precond : binary_search_lower_bound_precond seq target) : Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  lbLoop seq target 0 seq.size seq.size
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def binary_search_lower_bound_postcond (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (result : Nat) (h_precond : binary_search_lower_bound_precond seq target) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result ≤ seq.size ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, i < result → seq.getD i 0 < target) ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, result ≤ i ∧ i < seq.size → seq.getD i 0 ≥ target)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem lbLoop_zero (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (lo hi : Nat) :
    lbLoop seq target lo hi 0 = lo := by
  first
    | rfl
    | simp [lbLoop]
    | (unfold lbLoop; rfl)

theorem lbLoop_succ (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (lo hi f : Nat) :
    lbLoop seq target lo hi (f + 1) =
      (if lo < hi then
        (if seq.getD ((lo + hi) / 2) 0 < target then
            lbLoop seq target ((lo + hi) / 2 + 1) hi f
          else
            lbLoop seq target lo ((lo + hi) / 2) f)
      else lo) := by
  first
    | rfl
    | simp [lbLoop]
    | (unfold lbLoop; rfl)

theorem lbLoop_spec (seq : Array Int) (target : Int)
    (hs : ∀ i j : Nat, i < j ∧ j < seq.size → seq.getD i 0 ≤ seq.getD j 0) :
    ∀ (fuel lo hi : Nat), hi - lo ≤ fuel → lo ≤ hi → hi ≤ seq.size →
      (∀ i : Nat, i < lo → seq.getD i 0 < target) →
      (∀ i : Nat, hi ≤ i → i < seq.size → seq.getD i 0 ≥ target) →
      lbLoop seq target lo hi fuel ≤ seq.size ∧
      (∀ i : Nat, i < lbLoop seq target lo hi fuel → seq.getD i 0 < target) ∧
      (∀ i : Nat, lbLoop seq target lo hi fuel ≤ i → i < seq.size →
        seq.getD i 0 ≥ target) := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro lo hi hf hlo hhi h1 h2
    show lbLoop seq target lo hi 0 ≤ seq.size ∧
      (∀ i : Nat, i < lbLoop seq target lo hi 0 → seq.getD i 0 < target) ∧
      (∀ i : Nat, lbLoop seq target lo hi 0 ≤ i → i < seq.size →
        seq.getD i 0 ≥ target)
    rw [lbLoop_zero]
    refine ⟨by omega, h1, ?_⟩
    intro i hi1 hi2
    exact h2 i (by omega) hi2
  | succ f ih =>
    intro lo hi hf hlo hhi h1 h2
    show lbLoop seq target lo hi (f + 1) ≤ seq.size ∧
      (∀ i : Nat, i < lbLoop seq target lo hi (f + 1) → seq.getD i 0 < target) ∧
      (∀ i : Nat, lbLoop seq target lo hi (f + 1) ≤ i → i < seq.size →
        seq.getD i 0 ≥ target)
    rw [lbLoop_succ]
    by_cases hc : lo < hi
    · have hm1 : lo ≤ (lo + hi) / 2 := by omega
      have hm2 : (lo + hi) / 2 < hi := by omega
      rw [if_pos hc]
      by_cases hlt : seq.getD ((lo + hi) / 2) 0 < target
      · rw [if_pos hlt]
        refine ih ((lo + hi) / 2 + 1) hi (by omega) (by omega) hhi ?_ h2
        intro i hi1
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i ((lo + hi) / 2) with h | h
        · have hle := hs i ((lo + hi) / 2) ⟨h, by omega⟩
          linarith
        · have hEq : i = (lo + hi) / 2 := by omega
          subst hEq
          linarith
      · rw [if_neg hlt]
        push_neg at hlt
        refine ih lo ((lo + hi) / 2) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) h1 ?_
        intro i hi1 hi2
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge ((lo + hi) / 2) i with h | h
        · have hle := hs ((lo + hi) / 2) i ⟨h, hi2⟩
          linarith
        · have hEq : i = (lo + hi) / 2 := by omega
          subst hEq
          linarith
    · rw [if_neg hc]
      refine ⟨by omega, h1, ?_⟩
      intro i hi1 hi2
      exact h2 i (by omega) hi2
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem binary_search_lower_bound_postcond_satisfied (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (h_precond : binary_search_lower_bound_precond seq target) :
    binary_search_lower_bound_postcond seq target (binary_search_lower_bound seq target h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hs := h_precond.2
  obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ :=
    lbLoop_spec seq target hs seq.size 0 seq.size (by omega) (Nat.zero_le _)
      (le_refl _)
      (fun i hi => absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero i))
      (fun i hle hlt => absurd hlt (Nat.not_lt.mpr hle))
  exact ⟨a, b, fun i hi => c i hi.1 hi.2⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof

**Algorithm.** Classic lower‑bound binary search on `[lo, hi)`:
- if `lo = hi`, answer is `lo`;
- else `mid = (lo+hi)/2`; if `seq[mid] < target`, recurse on `[mid+1, hi)`, otherwise on `[lo, mid)`.

**Invariants.** All indices `< lo` have value `< target`, and all indices in `[hi, size)` have value `≥ target`. These are preserved:
- if `seq[mid] < target`, then by sortedness every `i ≤ mid` has `seq[i] ≤ seq[mid] < target`, so the invariant holds for the new `lo = mid+1`;
- if `seq[mid] ≥ target`, then every `i ≥ mid` (with `i < size`) has `seq[i] ≥ seq[mid] ≥ target`, so the invariant holds for the new `hi = mid`.

When the loop stops (`lo = hi`) the two invariants give exactly the postcondition.

**Implementation in Lean.** To get an easy structural recursion (and easy unfolding equations) I add a `fuel` parameter (each recursive call decreases the interval by at least 1, so `fuel = seq.size` suffices; the actual number of iterations is still `O(log n)`).

**Proof plan.**
1. `lbLoop_zero`, `lbLoop_succ`: unfolding equations.
2. `lbLoop_spec`: induction on `fuel`, generalizing `lo, hi`, carrying the two invariants plus `hi - lo ≤ fuel`, `lo ≤ hi`, `hi ≤ size`.
3. Instantiate with `lo = 0`, `hi = fuel = seq.size` (invariants hold vacuously).

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def binary_search_lower_bound_precond (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  seq.size ≤ 0x7FFFFFFF ∧
  (∀ i j : Nat, i < j ∧ j < seq.size → seq.getD i 0 ≤ seq.getD j 0)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def lbLoop (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (lo hi fuel : Nat) : Nat :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => lo
  | fuel + 1 =>
      if lo < hi then
        if seq.getD ((lo + hi) / 2) 0 < target then
          lbLoop seq target ((lo + hi) / 2 + 1) hi fuel
        else
          lbLoop seq target lo ((lo + hi) / 2) fuel
      else lo
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions

  lbLoop seq target 0 seq.size seq.size

  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result ≤ seq.size ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, i < result → seq.getD i 0 < target) ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, result ≤ i ∧ i < seq.size → seq.getD i 0 ≥ target)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

  first
    | rfl
    | simp [lbLoop]
    | (unfold lbLoop; rfl)

theorem lbLoop_succ (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (lo hi f : Nat) :

        (if seq.getD ((lo + hi) / 2) 0 < target then

          else
            lbLoop seq target lo ((lo + hi) / 2) f)
      else lo) := by

    | (unfold lbLoop; rfl)

    (hs : ∀ i j : Nat, i < j ∧ j < seq.size → seq.getD i 0 ≤ seq.getD j 0) :
    ∀ (fuel lo hi : Nat), hi - lo ≤ fuel → lo ≤ hi → hi ≤ seq.size →

- The search interval starts as `[0, seq.size)`.
- At each iteration, it computes `mid = (lo + hi) / 2`.
- If `seq[mid] < target`, it continues with `[mid + 1, hi)`.
- Otherwise, it continues with `[lo, mid)`.
- It returns `lo` when the interval is empty.
